accept_errors: reported split as DIAGNOSTICS 38: declined no_fit, declined displaced (fits alone), accepted
bounded: priorities and fund scores are 10·tanh(·/10) (never at the ±10 clip); no score penalty
closed_loop: candidate (greedy GNN turn heads, TurnCache) vs reference (default turns), same start stack, 16 monitor world-episodes × r0/r1, M5's floors (g, F); pass iff g ≥ −F, deaths, run-down and starvation shares no worse; 42 reported (atlas v2 train-split 42 worlds, 8 worlds × 1 fresh episode × r0/r1)
data: start stack + default turns: 112 M4 training world-episodes × r0/r1 (fit), 16 monitor world-episodes × r0/r1 (held out), horizon 100, 12 producers
excluded_pairs: pairs whose order the head's inputs cannot determine are left out of the loss and the metric: feature-identical pairs (same row features and the same linked capacity / input rows; the domain's tie-break keeps the default order) and, in the fund turn, replenishment vs replenishment (creation order, arbitrary); excluded counts reported by kind; the closed loop measures whether the unordered replenishment order matters
fitted: TurnHeads only (fresh seeded init); trunk, investment heads, orderer frozen
labels: default_turn_decision (accept bits; one priority order over reservations, pending claims and accepted bids) and default_fund_scores (fund order)
loss: BCE on accept bits + pairwise logistic on every ordered pair within a turn (≤ 400 sampled pairs per turn in training)
metric_scores: the offline metric scores the clipped (±10) outputs the closed loop acts on; saturation (share of outputs at the bound) reported; an L2 penalty (score_l2) on fund scores and priorities keeps the pairwise loss's growing margins inside the clip
offline_gate: held-out turns: accept agreement ≥ 0.99, pairwise rank agreement ≥ 0.99 for the accept-turn order and for the fund order; reported: share of turns whose whole schedule (accept set and order) equals the default's; failing → no closed loop
reported: identical-bid pairs with different default accept bits (in the closed loop both bids get the same bit, DIAGNOSTICS 36); held-out records and per-kind pair counts persisted (npz)
set_context: 2 self-attention layers (4 heads, pre-norm, no positional encoding, padding masked) over each turn's items after their per-item encoding: the fund requests; the bids and claims together. No hand-built set feature.
stage: EXP-0120: turn-head imitation with learned set context (v13 + DIAGNOSTICS 38's fix)
supersedes: m6_prereg_v13 (97474c22…, EXP-0118 offline_fail: a per-bid head cannot imitate the cumulative auction)
